# Research scope and reproducibility rules

1. This project tests functional consequences of the hypothesis (recall, interference, robustness to chemical noise). It does not test or claim anything about consciousness. Do not write code comments, README text, plot titles, or variable names that claim otherwise.
2. The authors state they have not shown AI cannot be conscious. Do not misrepresent them.
3. Every result must be reproducible: fixed seeds, config files, no hidden constants.
4. Report negative results as plainly as positive ones.
5. Work one task at a time. After each task, run the tests and commit.
